text: Ava Chen: quick design question — for the Metrics dashboard chart, do we expose a compact/abbrev toggle (e.g. 12.3k, 1.2M) or always show full values with a legend hint? also thinking about how outliers should be surfaced: clip to y-axis vs show and mark as ‘outlier’ badge. thoughts? :eyes: Rohit Patel: I'd prefer a toggle. compact helps scanability for most users, but full values are important on hover. toggle could be global (console-level) or per-chart. per-chart seems noisy. Marisol Vega: agree per-chart is noisy. global with a per-chart override in settings maybe. wording: `Compact numbers (1k, 1M)` — short and clear. Samir G.: implementation note: the formatter has to be consistent with the tooltip and CSV export. if we abbreviate the axis, tooltip should always show full precise value. Lukas Rivera: +1 to the tooltip showing full values. copy suggestion for the toggle: "Compact numbers — shorten axis labels (1.2k)". small and descriptive. Ava Chen: good. what about the outlier policy? clip to axis (and show a chevron) or show full and annotate? clipping saves vertical space but can hide magnitude. Rohit Patel: show full and annotate with a small badge on the point: "!" or label "outlier". we can also add an optional y-axis zoom button when a big spike is present. Marisol Vega: accessibility nit — if we show a badge we need an accessible label. e.g. `aria-label="outlier: 12,345 requests"` and it should be keyboard focusable. Samir G.: example aria snippet: ``` ⚠️ ``` Also we'll expose a setting name for screen reader users: "Number formatting: compact / full". design-bot: accessibility checklist: ensure axis tick text has sufficient contrast, toggles are reachable by keyboard, provide `aria-live` region for dynamic value changes. Ava Chen: copy pieces to finalize — toggle label, tooltip microcopy, outlier badge label. Drafts: Toggle: "Number format: Compact / Full"; Tooltip footer: "Exact: 12,345"; Outlier badge aria: "Outlier — value: 12,345". feedback? Lukas Rivera: tweak the toggle to "Number format: Compact / Exact" — Exact reads clearer than Full. Marisol Vega: prefer "Exact" too. Also request a tiny hint under the toggle in the settings panel: "Compact shortens axis labels; hover to see exact values." small grey text. Rohit Patel: sounds good. devs: Samir, can you add a feature flag for the global toggle so we can test rollout? might want server-side default per-org. Samir G.: yea I'll add a FF. plan: client flag -> CSS class on charts -> formatter switch. will ensure CSV uses exact by default. Ava Chen: awesome. last ask: for the legend, should we show the unit (ms, req/s) inline or in chart header? I think inline next to metric name is clearer. Marisol Vega: inline next to metric name + visually muted color. also make sure screen readers read the unit after the name: "Latency, milliseconds". Ava Chen: perfect. I'll update the prototype with these copy tweaks and ARIA notes, and post a new screenshot in ~1h. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
